text: The main elevator in the science block is stuck on the third floor with doors jammed shut
Passenger lift B is making loud grinding sounds and jerks violently between floors
Wheelchair lift call button on floor 2 is unresponsive and does not illuminate
Elevator door sensors are misaligned causing the doors to close too quickly on wheelchairs
The library elevator floor indicator screen is blank but the lift operates normally
Hydraulic lift for the auditorium stage is out of service and powered off
Elevator interior emergency phone is dead and makes no dial tone
Lift button 4 inside the cabin is loose and wobbly when pushed
Elevator ride is shaky and stops 2 inches below the floor level
Freight elevator used for mobility access is shut down for scheduled inspection
The concrete access ramp outside the dining hall is completely blocked by wooden shipping pallets
Multiple delivery bicycles are chained to the wheelchair ramp railing obstructing passage
Construction scaffolding has been erected directly across the library entrance ramp
A commercial delivery van is parked over the sidewalk curb cut ramp
Large commercial garbage dumpsters are obstructing the side wheelchair ramp
A sandwich board advertisement sign was placed in the middle of the access ramp walkway
Wet leaves and mud have accumulated on the ramp making the slope dangerously slippery
A row of decorative planters narrows the ramp width to less than 70 centimeters
Temporary water hose is stretched across the ramp creating a 3 inch tripping barrier
Loose gravel scattered across the ramp surface causes wheelchair wheels to spin and lose traction
Automatic power doors at the main entrance are switched off and cannot be pushed open
The automated wheelchair push paddle switch at the west entrance is detached and broken
Front entrance only has four steep concrete stairs with no step-free alternate route
Heavy manual double doors have excessive spring tension and cannot be pulled open from a wheelchair
Revolving door is jammed and the adjacent accessible handicap door is locked from the inside
Entrance door threshold has a sharp 4 inch raised edge that wheelchairs cannot roll over
Turnstile card reader at the accessible entrance gate is installed too high for seated users
Door intercom button to call reception for accessible entry assistance is disconnected and dead
Weather stripping at the entrance door threshold is torn and catches on wheelchair castors
Magnetic lock on the accessible entry door keeps buzzing and fails to unlock intermittently
Tactile paving blister pavers are cracked and missing in front of the lobby stairwell
Braille room number sign on the first floor accessible restroom is completely missing
Fluorescent light fixture in the accessible corridor is flickering rapidly causing severe glare
Directional accessibility signage pointing toward the accessible elevator has fallen down
Handrail along the corridor access walkway is loose and wiggles when grasped for support
Water leak from the ceiling has created a large puddle across the main accessible corridor
Acoustic reverberation and loud ventilation rumble makes audio announcements unintelligible
Accessible parking space painted blue symbol is completely faded and illegible
Carpet edge trim in the second floor hallway has lifted creating a 2 inch lip hazard
Emergency strobe light in the accessible bathroom is unplugged and unpowered
